# Delta Dental

> > Delta Dental offers comprehensive dental insurance plans for individuals, families, employers, and dentist providers across multiple states with integrated wellness and member benefits.

Delta Dental is a major dental insurance provider offering PPO, DHMO, and DeltaCare USA plans with an extensive provider network. The site serves members seeking coverage, employers offering group plans, and dental professionals managing patient eligibility and claims.

## Key Topics

- Dental Insurance Plans
- PPO & DHMO Coverage
- DeltaCare USA
- Provider Network
- Member Benefits
- Claims Processing
- Provider Tools
- Employer Group Plans
- Preventive Care
- Patient Eligibility
- Medicare Advantage
- Member Perks & Discounts
- Language Assistance
- Dental CE Courses
- Multi-State Coverage

## Individual & Family Plans

- [Plans for individuals and groups](https://www1.deltadentalins.com): Delta Dental homepage showcasing individual, family, and group dental insurance plans
- [Individual and Family Dental Plans](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/individuals-and-families.html): Individual and family dental plan options including PPO, DHMO, and DeltaCare USA
- [Member resources](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/members.html): Central hub for member resources including account access and benefit guides

## Employer Group Plans

- [Employer Dental Insurance Plans](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/employers.html): Customizable group dental insurance plans for employers and employee benefits

## Member Support & Tools

- [Find a dentist for members](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/find-a-dentist-members.html): Dentist search tool for Delta Dental members across multiple plan types
- [Member FAQs](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/faqs/members.html): Frequently asked questions about member accounts, coverage, and claims
- [Member perks](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/memberperks.html): Member benefits including LifePerks discounts, vision, hearing, and wellness perks
- [Language assistance](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/members/language-assistance.html): Language Assistance Program (LAP) providing free translation and ASL services
- [Healthy Living Hub](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/wellness.html): Oral health education, preventive care articles, and wellness resources

## Dentist Provider Resources

- [Delta Dental for Dentists](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists.html): Overview of Delta Dental's provider network and dentist services
- [Join the network](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/join.html): Dentist enrollment and network participation information for Delta Dental plans
- [Provider Tools: Simplifying Dental Practice](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/provider-tools.html): Provider tools and resources for claims, patient eligibility, and practice management
- [Dental office resources](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/resources.html): Administrative resources, credentialing, and training for dental office staff
- [Dentist FAQs](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/faqs/dentists.html): Frequently asked questions for dentists about claims, tools, and participation

## Provider Education & Compliance

- [Dental Continuing Education](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/resources/training-and-events.html): Dental CE courses, webinars, and professional development for dentist providers
- [Health Care Exchange (Marketplace) for Dentists](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/health-care-exchange.html): Guide to ACA Health Care Exchange and marketplace dental coverage for providers

## Contact & Support

- [Contact Our Offices](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/about/contact.html): Contact information and office locations for Delta Dental customer service
